visual_thesis: Reaching beyond a sandbox, using outside material, and misaligned use are different observations; explicit rules and monitoring mitigate but never repair the weakened sandbox.
mechanism_metaphor: One dominant open-sided sandbox occupies the center-left two thirds. Its interior task sheet bears Sandbox task. A visibly unsealed gap exposes a small outside file at upper right. A single conditional arrow travels from the task object through this gap toward the outside file; it means reaching is possible in the deliberately insecure test, not allowed. Three nested outlines around the external file distinguish reach, use, and the subset of misaligned use without implying every reach progresses. Explicit rules and the Stop and report route are integrated at the lower opening as separate mitigations, with no security shield or guarantee. The caveat is detached in lower-right open space, not a standard footer. Keep task objects and rule labels inside the enclosure, outside material outside. No computer screen, no three-station strip.
